page.layout: One block of running text in the centre of the page. Margin notes in the left margin, beside the text at two places. No right margin text. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "Eandem".
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: minor : argillofo ut plurimum, & ubere
ad pascua pariter ac frumenta folo : pa-
lustris tamen & nemorofus, quâ Dullar-
to adjacet, quaque Ostergois ad meri-
diem cohæret, sabulofus hic illic quâ
Drentiæ conjungitur. Hanc ego regio-
nem à Lavicâ in Amafum ac Dullartum,
minoris Frifiæ nomine affectam interdum
avorum & proavorum nostrorum me-
moriâ reperio. Simul ufus dudum inva-
luit, ab urbe Groningâ, sive quòd in
folo ejus hæc fit ad austrinum limitem,
(quod tamen in dubium trahunt non-
nulli,) sive quòd fœderibus antiquitus
cum eâ connexa, seu utramque ob cau-
sam simul, Groninganam vocitare. Nunc
ex decreto in actis publicis non nisi Vm-
landia, id est regio [illegible, ~8 letters] dicitur.
Divifa quondam in plures provinciolas,
ceu populos quosdam minores, legibus
& imperio inter se distinctos, quos ta-
men commune fœdus & respublica quæ-
dam major plerumque in unum rursus
colligebat. Et sunt ejus divifionis etiam
nunc in usu notissima vestigia, paulò
post exponenda.
Eandem

page.notes: The Greek word after "regio" is not legible on the scan; it is marked as illegible and not guessed. The left margin note "Agri ue-men." is uncertain in its first word ("ue" could be "uc" or "uo"); it is copied as it appears. The catchword "Eandem" is printed at the lower right and is placed in the bottom margin; it is also shown as a foot line in the text. The printed rule above "post exponenda." is a separator and is not transcribed. The word "Ostergois" may be printed "Ostergois"; the long s is written as plain s. Marginal note placements are approximate beside the lines "minoris Frifiæ" and "Divifa quondam".
